items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Paul Piazza was in it... Paul Piazza played trumpet and George Bracey was the leader... I played clown at the end of that band.

ctx.x: I've been a tell about the terminal. Paul Piazza was in it. George Bracey. Louis Rodriguez.
Now, which instrument did Paul Piazza play? Trumpet. Yeah.
